// FUNC 1801b5480 __alloca_probe
unsigned __int64 __fastcall _alloca_probe()
{
  unsigned __int64 result; // rax
  char *v1; // r10
  char *StackLimit; // r11
  char v3; // [rsp+18h] [rbp+8h] BYREF

  v1 = &v3 - result;
  if ( (unsigned __int64)&v3 < result )
    v1 = nullptr;
  StackLimit = (char *)NtCurrentTeb()->NtTib.StackLimit;
  if ( v1 < StackLimit )
  {
    LOWORD(v1) = (unsigned __int16)v1 & 0xF000;
    do
    {
      StackLimit -= 4096;
      *StackLimit = 0;
    }
    while ( v1 != StackLimit );
  }
  return result;
}

// FUNC 1801b54d0 ?dllmain_crt_dispatch@@YAHQEAUHINSTANCE__@@KQEAX@Z

// FUNC 1801b84cc capture_current_context
struct _IMAGE_RUNTIME_FUNCTION_ENTRY *__fastcall capture_current_context(PCONTEXT ContextRecord)
{

  struct _IMAGE_RUNTIME_FUNCTION_ENTRY *result; // rax

                                                     nullptr);
